Episode 167. The Fifth Tomb of Temar (2)
Jin's pupils dilated.
"Luntia... Sister?"

He couldn't have even imagined that he would encounter Luntia here instead of Valeria. The excitement that stemmed from finally finding a trace of Valeria turned into unpleasant anxiety like rotten oil in an instant.
"Why are you here, Sister?"
Luntia's love sword, the tri-blade Sharl, was shimmering, full of black chaos. Jin could do nothing but stare at his second sister like a man who had lost his soul for a few seconds.
Luntia, too, looked at Jin silently for a while. It wasn't easy to read what emotions were contained in her darkened eyes.
On the other hand, Luntia clearly recognized Jin's emotions.
[It seems you dislike it, that I have appeared before you now.]
Jin repeated Luntia's words and unconsciously dropped his head.
A very strange and dreadful pain that he had only experienced a few times in his entire life was scratching at Jin's inner self.
The sorrow of losing a family.
That's the pain.
The fact that Luntia was tainted by chaos was something he had already expected. Jin, however, had hoped that she wasn't completely consumed.
Raising his head again, Jin stared at the black horn on his sister's forehead. She had already crossed a river from which there was no return.
"I trusted you, Sister."
[Did such trust exist between you and me?]
Luntia had never been close to any of her siblings.
She had believed that only Luna gave meaning to her life. She wanted to follow her sister for life, whether she won or lost in the competition with her.
So, since Luna abdicated the seat of the next family head at the age of nineteen, Luntia's world was nothing but a meaningless series of monochrome.
The moment when Luntia began to harbor a fire in her heart again was precisely in 1799.
The very day Jin declared himself the family head.
The incident between Jin and Luntia at the time was far from an act of building brotherhood. They simply fought to the death until one fell.
Furthermore, after the incident, the two did not have a long conversation.
"-I, too, will become a family head.
-I thought you were just a bumpkin, but it turns out you have some real guts. Let's do our best, sister."
That was all there was to it, but Jin felt that a deep bond had formed between him and Luntia at that moment.
Despite having lived a lifetime as strangers, they had finally become siblings with the same dream through a single fight.
Luntia, he thought, must have felt the same.
That's why Jin, before going to the third Lafrarosa, believed that Luntia would be able to effectively hold back the Prophet.
"Did Rosa and the Prophet catch any of your weaknesses?"
Luntia could not have accepted the chaos voluntarily. Jin was certain that the tricks of Rosa and the Prophet had broken her.
To his words, Luntia, while flashing a sharp smile like a crescent moon, stroked her horn.
[What changes if I answer that?]
"There must be a way I can help you, sister."
[Ha ha… I wonder if this is the 12th generation I know. You're sounding bold. Pull yourself together, Jin Runcandel, my youngest brother. I stand here now as your enemy.]
Luntia slowly lifted the tri-blade Sharl and pointed it at Jin.
[What you should do is only to fight back. That's what I mean. I have been waiting for this moment for quite a long time. The moment I can have another contest with you.]
Luntia's dark eyes, which were difficult to read throughout, were now filled with a flickering will to live.
A demonic madness.
Though capable of dialogue as if she was sane, Luntia was fully consumed by chaos. A deep and fierce will to kill was already stabbing at Jin through the tip of Sharl.
Jin decided to control his emotions. This wasn't an opponent he could fight while swayed by sorrow, torment, or any sort of guilt.
It was an unavoidable fight. Therefore, it was right to end it as quickly as possible, even for Luntia's sake. Maybe even to save Valeria, who was likely affected by Luntia.
Gradually, Jin's pupils hardened. Luntia nodded her head as if she was satisfied with Jin's demeanor.
[That's right, you should face me like that. But you seem quite exhausted, youngest brother.]
Chrrr-!
Suddenly, Luntia lunged her sword, and Jin stepped aside.
The stab that threatened Jin with death from the first blow when he declared himself a family head. Luntia's sword had achieved much higher than it did back then.

[Even so, you've become inexplicably stronger. Thanks to that, my boring destiny will be a little more enjoyable. When I first fought with you in the past, I too had many limitations. Think of your reaching me exhausted as the price of that time.]
Even while dyed in chaos, Luntia didn't lose the status of a transcended warrior at all, much like characters like Stan, Padler, and Rosa.
From the start, Luntia was pushing Jin back. Her sword aura left cracks and sharp afterimages in the dark void, surrounding Jin.
'She is strong. Even stronger than Lionel Runcandel.'
In fact, he felt it was even more challenging than when Lionel and Stan were attacking together.
Not only the size or intensity of power, but it was because she was 'dominating' this void.
The attack path of Shal is not linear. Every time Shal moved, the void twisted and followed Luntia's will, arbitrarily changing the path.
It was as if Jin was dealing with the whole void, not just Luntia, he quickly realized this fact.
'So, when I first entered here, the reason I didn't feel any guiding spirit like in other tombs was because Luntia took over the entire tomb?'
A drop of blood dripped from a newly formed afterimage. Thanks to Jin's quick reaction, he only had such minor injuries and figured out the characteristics of Luntia and the void.
Fzzt!
A blue lightning from Sigmund tore through the chaotic sword aura coming towards him. And then, both of them used their family's secret skills at the same time.
Thunder and chaos, the 5th secret skill enhanced by their respective abilities, Light Speed Stab. The two sword auras stretched out seemed to pierce each other's chests.
However, both of them had already predicted each other's moves and were stepping aside.
Suddenly, the whole void was split in half. The two sword auras that passed each other hit the end of the void emptily.
Luntia looked at the end for a moment, and Jin didn't.
'Do you remember? The day I first confronted your thunder, I saved many knights from you. Now I'm playing the role of protecting the family from you again.'
'...... How did you get in here?'
'Isn't it obvious?'
'I know that the Prophet played some trick. But this space was originally prepared for me. I don't understand why Solderet's void behaves as if you're the master.'
'The same goes for that. But I guess what you're really curious about is something else.'
'I'll find Hister after I defeat you.'
'You seem to suspect that the redhead woman is still alive.'
'It seems you're not perfectly controlling this space, Luntia. Did you not know that Hister's magic remains in this void?'
At that, Luntia narrowed her brows.

'Hmm, that's quite interesting if it's true. If magic remains, it means that the spellcaster is still alive. I knew that woman was hiding somewhere here. I just assumed she would have been dead by now.'"
"Is that because you inflicted a severe injury on Hister?"
Luntia nodded.
'If that's the case, if she's alive, it's likely due to her accepting chaos. She wouldn't have survived without that level of regeneration.'
Jin didn't react sensitively to that.
"There's no way that's the case, sister. If so, the magic I saw should have already been tainted with spirit of chaos. Anyway, thank you. I'm now more confident that Hister has survived."
'So the remaining task is to defeat me and save her?'
Luntia, saying so, showed signs of displeasure for the first time.
'You and sister Luna always assume that. You always assume you can naturally overcome any opponent and seize what you want, regardless of the situation.'
"In fact, it has always been that way. This time won't be any different."
As Luntia's anger surged, the void began to vibrate. Jin couldn't discern if her sudden outburst of anger was just due to madness, or if there was another reason.
From the moment he regained his calm.
The words Luntia spat out no longer hurt Jin. None of them were really from 'Luntia Runcandel'.
Even Ron High had blamed Jin from the depths of Gleeak.
"I will soon stop the madness that has consumed you, sister."
Aura gathered in Jin's Gwangsimjang.
'Dragging out the battle is disadvantageous.'

From the start, Jin had begun the fight exhausted, while Luntia was in perfect condition. Furthermore, she was using the entire void for her energy, and showed signs of immediate recovery through chaos energy even when she was injured.
If possible, he had to finish it in one go.
'I have to consider the battle situation after escaping from the void... but I should trust Zipfel and Kinzelo for that issue.'
If he clumsily tried to conserve his energy, he wouldn't be able to avoid serious injury.
'You're trying to use the sword from the day you declared your position as the head of the family...'
"Unlike then, now there's nothing you need to protect."
But just like then, you won't be able to withstand this sword again.
As Jin began to pull out the Sword of King's Domination while continuing his words, Luntia showed a slight smile.
